rules: Earlier constructors retain their original diagnostic families.
Wrong constructor arity or value types retain OKL-E-TYPE; dimension errors retain OKL-E-UNIT.
Existing keyed-value, material, placement, rotation and resource diagnostics retain their meanings.
Include the source occurrence/span and boundary kind, pocket key, vertex key, order or region when relevant and available.
Never catch cancellation or arbitrary callback exceptions and convert them into a geometry diagnostic.
A source-valid delivery geometry refusal must not be relabeled from a resource exhaustion.

diagnostics.meaning: Malformed pocket value, invalid pocket key, duplicate native pocket identity or pocket count outside zero through eight.
Malformed vertex value, invalid or duplicate native vertex key, fewer than three vertices on a boundary or more than 64 total authored boundary vertices.
A pocket or within-boundary vertex order is not a unique integer in [0,65535].
A native planar point is malformed, nonfinite or outside [-100,100] meters.
Body height is nonfinite or outside canonical binary64 [0.001,100] meters.
Pocket depth is nonfinite, outside canonical binary64 [0.001,100] meters, or reaches/passes the body bottom.
A positive nonpenetrating pocket depth leaves an exact rational base smaller than canonical binary64 0.001 meter.
Duplicate points, zero/collinear/backtracking edges, boundary crossing/touching/overlap, zero area, invalid exact cap coverage or invalid complete source mesh incidence/contact.
The exterior is not counterclockwise or a pocket is not clockwise as viewed from +Z.
A pocket is not strictly inside the exterior, or pockets are nested instead of mutually exterior.
An exterior/pocket wall, bottom, top or pocket floor region is malformed or absent from the palette.

Rounded source or actual delivered positions/normals fail representability, floor separation, distinct identity, outward nonzero face, closed incidence, shared-simplex contact, positive-volume or existing geometric-error requirements.

validation_precedence: Source arity/type/unit and keyed-value admission keep their existing order.
Bounded immutable native snapshot and aggregate counts precede subsequent callback-driven geometry work.
Admit body height before dependent pocket depth/base arithmetic.
Classify an out-of-range or penetrating depth as DEPTH; only an otherwise valid positive depth leaving an insufficient exact base is BASE.
For each simple nonzero boundary, use WINDING for reversed orientation; crossings, duplicate points and collinear edges remain TOPOLOGY.
Boundary intersections use TOPOLOGY; strictly separated outside or nested boundaries use CONTAINMENT.
Actual delivered precision/contact failures use NUMERIC and preserve the actual export failure state.
